data.body: Fix landed as Gerrit change 3095, commit 67137e66e99 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1). Locally, make verify failed only the 17 known pandoc x86_64-on-arm64 tests in 3 reconciler files; Linux CI passed. Not yet observed: the last acceptance criterion (a live comment-only config commit staying quiet after deploy). Review advisories left open on purpose: (1) config_changed's driving git diff hides its own failure and then signals nothing, which matches the old changed_range behaviour, so it is not a regression; (2) the unquoted for-loop word-splits a watched path containing whitespace, and no watched path has any today; (3) the deployed-side-unreadable branch has no test.
